OOP Final Project

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Admin
    System administrator: manages user accounts and reads audit logs.
    CitationFormat
     
    CitationsComparator
    Sorts papers by citation count — most cited first.
    Comment
    A comment left by a user under a news entry.
    Course
    A university course.
    CourseType
     
    CreditLimitException
    Thrown when a student tries to register for courses exceeding 21 credits.
    DataStore
    Singleton holding all in-memory state and persistence.
    DateComparator
    Sorts papers by date published — newest first.
    Employee
    Abstract employee of the university.
    Language
    Preferred display language for a user.
    Lesson
    A single lecture or practice slot of a course.
    LessonType
     
    LowHIndexException
    Thrown when a researcher with h-index < 3 is assigned as a supervisor.
    Manager
    Academic manager.
    ManagerType
     
    Mark
    Course mark made of three components — 1st attestation (0..30), 2nd attestation (0..30), final exam (0..40).
    MaxFailedReachedException
    Thrown when a student fails a course for the 3rd time.
    Message
    A message sent from one user to another.
    News
    A news entry published by a manager.
    NotAResearcherException
    Thrown when a non-researcher tries to join a ResearchProject.
    PaperLengthComparator
    Sorts papers by length (page count) — longest first.
    Request
    A request submitted by an Employee that has to be signed by a Manager (acting as dean / rector) before it can be approved or rejected.
    RequestStatus
    Status of an employee Request.
    Researcher
    Anyone capable of doing research.
    ResearcherDecorator
    Decorator that gives any User the Researcher role without modifying their class.
    ResearcherEmployee
    An employee whose only role is research (not Teacher, not Manager, not Admin).
    ResearchPaper
    Academic paper authored by one or more Researchers.
    ResearchProject
    A long-running research effort with a topic, participants, and the papers that came out of it.
    Student
    Bachelor student (1..4 years).
    Teacher
    Teaching staff.
    TeacherTitle
    Teacher academic title.
    UniversityDemo
    End-to-end demo class.
    UrgencyLevel
     
    User
    Abstract base of every person in the system.
    UserAction
    Audit-log entry: who did what, when.
    UserFactory
    Factory pattern.
    UserType
